source.title: MDE Maryland's Certified Drinking Water Laboratories PDF (Latest Revisions 10/1/2026) + LCP hub + Be Well Wise + MDH Water Microbiology / Well Water Testing Fees + UMD Extension Water Testing
limitations: MDE Certified DW Labs PDF (Latest Revisions 10/1/2026) lists in-state and out-of-state certified labs with name, address, head of laboratory, phone, MD Lab Certification Number, and approved-test codes. Private-well sample acceptance is not stated per commercial row — marked unknown; call first.

Table includes 22 in-state commercial/independent labs (numeric cert IDs, Maryland addresses). Municipal/utility/plant labs with G-#### cert numbers omitted. Evitts Creek Water Company (Bedford, PA address) and all out-of-state labs on pages 4–7 omitted — use the official PDF.

Verified private-well paths are agency-level: (1) local health department submission to MDH Laboratories Administration Water Microbiology (private well sample reports mailed to submitting LHD) with published Well Water Testing Fees; (2) MDE Be Well Wise guidance to use a state-certified drinking-water laboratory for annual private-well sampling.
UMD Extension Certified Water Testing Labs page last updated 2019 and marked possibly outdated by Extension — not used to mark per-lab private-well acceptance; current MDE PDF is the roster source.
MDE PFAS private-well factsheet (March 2023): generally the state does not fund or provide testing for private well owners; contact local health department for possible assistance.
Fees intentionally omitted from the table — confirm with the lab / local health department / MDH Well Water Testing Fees page.
Approved-test codes refer to MDE's Approved Analyte List on the LCP homepage — not expanded inventively here.
Kansas KDHE AB Manager remains JS-only without a verified static export — skipped again.

verified_paths.name: Local health department → MDH Laboratories Administration (Water Microbiology / Well Water Testing Fees)
verified_paths.notes: MDH Water Microbiology page states private well sample reports are mailed to the submitting local health department. MDH Well Water Testing Fees page publishes fees for Bacteriology, Nitrate-Nitrate, Turbidity, metals, and other analytes. Contact your county health department to arrange submission; call MDH Water Microbiology at 443-681-3960 with laboratory questions. Confirm current fees on the official fees page — not republished in the directory table.

verified_paths.name: MDE Be Well Wise — state-certified laboratory path for private well owners
verified_paths.notes: MDE states about 350,000 Maryland households rely on private wells; owners are responsible for testing. Have water tested periodically by a state-certified laboratory. Annual sampling: total coliform bacteria, nitrates, total dissolved solids, and pH. Local health departments, University of Maryland Extension, and others can help identify local contaminant concerns. Water Well Construction Program: 410-537-3784. Choose labs from the current MDE Certified DW Labs PDF; call each lab to confirm private-well acceptance and packages.
